selected_anchor: HaCasa Nova mobile composition; original default components and desktop behavior
evidence_caveat: Most independently shared adaptations found are for legacy HaCasa v1/v2, not Nova v3.1. Do not treat their YAML or custom-card APIs as compatible Nova extensions.

references.creator: sam_y14
references.title: My new dashboard using HaCasa
references.observed: Compact date/weather header, household avatars, summary strip and gold active surfaces; room control groups below.
references.application: Keep household context concise; use the existing three persons if adding presence. Do not copy its energy, waste or TV cards: this home's matching sensors/devices are not established. Retain selected Nova navigation instead of importing legacy YAML.

references.creator: markwdw
references.title: HaCasa Washing Machine Card
references.observed: Wide appliance card with a readable program label, finish time and restrained progress bar.
references.application: Use this information hierarchy when adapting existing LG washer readings. Its Gorenje/ConnectLife numeric programs and extra options are incompatible evidence for this home's washer. Keep the existing washer read-only; no invented program or finish state.

references.creator: chintito4ever
references.title: Community HaCasa lock and cover cards
references.observed: New device controls keep the existing typography, warm active fill and simple state/action arrangement.
references.application: Extend only genuine missing capabilities, using one existing visual language. No locks or covers are added to this home; no adoption of the legacy card code.

references.creator: jlnbln
references.title: Rounded-Bubble: HaCasa-derived media, room and server pages
references.observed: Combines Rounded and HaCasa with a dense mobile navigation bar and large room tiles.
references.application: Existing project inspiration; useful evidence of cross-page consistency but not the chosen layout. Do not reintroduce this crowded navigation.

references.creator: Damian Eickhoff
references.title: HaCasa Nova creator showcase and 3.1 update
references.application: Primary layout anchor. Pin v3.1.0, use current per-user settings and explicit Add card entries, and keep the existing dashboard available during compatibility testing.

concrete_choice_for_draft: Retain upstream Nova mobile/desktop UI; explicitly add eight fan entities and the declared Echo groups and dishwasher; retain existing guarded Atomberg and private household flows through More. No speculative controls or forced theme override on legacy views.
